blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scientific workflows often require choosing among known relations before a deterministic calculation can proceed. Whether observations share a culture, treatment or reference standard can change the scientific meaning of the resulting count or comparison. We evaluate Jev as a semantic decision component using a harness that follows its documented guidance and assigns arithmetic to code. The study compares twelve model configurations on twenty source-grounded Choices across ten scientific cases, each repeated five times. We measure semantic selections, downstream outputs and final claim labels separately. Jev matched five other configurations at complete semantic correctness and achieved the lowest observed median latency among successful responses. Across three comparison models, seven wrong selections on one culture-history question changed downstream counts while preserving the correct final label. These results identify a useful role for Jev in prepared scientific decision tasks and show why evaluating that role requires checking the relations and quantities that a workflow will reuse.
blocks.zh: 科学工作流程往往要求在进行确定性计算之前,在已知的关系中作出选择。 观测是否共享一个文化,处理或参考标准,可以改变所得出的计数或比较的科学意义. 我们评价Jev是一个语义决定部分,使用一种遵循其文献指导并分配算术来编码的绳索。 该研究比较了十种科学案例的二十种基于来源的选择的十二种模型配置,每次重复五次. 我们分别衡量语义选择、下游产出和最后索赔标签。 Jev在完全语义正确性方面与另外五个配置进行了匹配,在成功反应中实现了观测到的最低中位延迟。 在三个比较模型中,一个文化-历史问题的七个错误选择改变了下游的计数,同时保留了正确的最终标签。 这些结果确定了Jev在已准备好的科学决策任务中的有益作用,并表明为什么评价这一作用需要检查工作流程将重复使用的关系和数量。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Scientific workflows often turn on small decisions about what an observation represents. Ten measurements may describe independently grown cultures or repeated samples from a single culture. That distinction determines what a program should count and which claims the evidence supports. Similar decisions arise when identifying shared calibration standards, paired simulations or experimental assignments. Their answer spaces can be finite even when selecting the appropriate relation requires interpreting scientific language.
blocks.zh: 科学工作流程往往取决于对观察所代表的内容作出小的决定。 十种测量可以描述独立生长的培养物或从单一培养物中重复的样本. 这种区分决定了程序应该统计什么,谁声称证据支持。 在确定共同校准标准、配对模拟或实验性任务时,也会产生类似的决定。 即使选择适当的关系需要解释科学语言,它们的答案空间也可能是有限的。

blocks.en: This interface between language and computation is a natural setting for Jev, a model designed to answer typed questions about supplied state ( TypeSafe AI, 2026b ) . Its Choice interface selects from explicit candidates ( TypeSafe AI, 2026a ) . The documented division of labor assigns numerical operations to code and semantic judgments to the model ( TypeSafe AI, 2026c ) . For scientific applications, the practical question is whether these judgments remain correct at useful request cost and latency, and whether their downstream consequences are captured by evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这种语言和计算之间的界面是Jev的自然设置,这个模型旨在解答关于供给状态的打字问题(TypeSafe AI, 2026b ). 它的Choice接口从明确候选人中选择(TypeSafe AI,2026a). 文件记载的分工将数字操作指定给模型的代码和语义判断(TypeSafe AI, 2026c.). 就科学应用而言,实际的问题是,这些判断是否在有用的要求下仍然正确,费用和耐久性如何,其下游后果是否通过评价得到反映。

blocks.en: Scientific question answering and claim verification already provide relevant evaluation settings. PubMedQA pairs research questions with abstract context ( Jin et al., 2019 ) , and Jevals uses a binary version to evaluate Jev ( Jevals, 2026 ) . SciFact evaluates scientific claims together with supporting evidence ( Wadden et al., 2020 ) . More recently, Ho et al. (2025) showed that correct scientific claim labels can coexist with incorrect cell-level rationales. We examine executable relations: a selected relation controls a specified calculation, exposing whether a correct label accompanies a correct scientific output.
blocks.zh: 科学问题回答和索赔核实已经提供了相关的评价环境。 PubMedQA配对抽象背景的研究问题(Jin等人,2019年),Jevals使用二进制版本评价Jev(Jevals,2026年). SciFact评价科学主张和佐证(Wadden等人,2020年). 最近,Ho等人(2025年)表明,正确的科学诉求标签可以与不正确的细胞层原理共存. 我们检查可执行关系:一个选定的关系控制一个指定的计算,揭示一个正确的标签是否伴随一个正确的科学输出.

blocks.en: We contribute source-grounded scientific decision materials, a shared harness implementing the documented code–model division, and a comparison of Jev with eleven other configurations. Our analysis connects semantic correctness to derived outputs and final labels, and compares request latency and response cost. This provides concrete evidence for choosing a model at a bounded decision point within a scientific workflow.
blocks.zh: 我们提供以源头为基础的科学决策材料、执行有文件记载的代码-模型划分的共享工具,以及将Jev与其他11个配置进行比较。 我们的分析将语义正确性与衍生产出和最终标签联系起来,并比较了请求的延迟性和响应成本. 这为在科学工作流程内的限定决策点选择模型提供了具体证据。

blocks.en: 2 Scientific Decisions and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2 科学决定和评价

blocks.en: 2.1 Cases and the shared harness
blocks.zh: 2.1 案件和共享手段

blocks.en: The model comparison uses twenty scientific Choices in ten cases, with two questions per case. The questions concern experimental units, shared histories, dependence and protocol applicability. Sources span manufacturing and materials, physical simulations, climate, metrology and biological experiments. These cases belong to a development collection of forty scientific Choices in twenty case groups, plus one engineering control. Passage-specific code rules resolve the other twenty scientific Choices without a model call. Appendix A explains the question types, scientific cases and reference interpretations.
blocks.zh: 模型比较在十个案例中采用20个科学选择,每个案例有两个问题. 这些问题涉及实验单位、共享历史、依赖性和协议适用性。 来源包括制造和材料、物理模拟、气候、计量和生物实验。 这些案件属于20个案例组的40个科学选择的开发集,加上一个工程控制. 通道专用代码规则解决了其他20个科学选择,没有模型调用. 附 录 A解释问题类型、科学案例和参考解释。

blocks.en: Each model receives the same prepared evidence passages, structured records, question instructions and candidate meanings. The packets contain source-grounded adaptations and transcriptions; reference answers and the constructed claims being assessed are kept outside model inputs.
blocks.zh: 每个模型都收到同样准备好的证据段落、结构化记录、问题说明和候选含义。 这些包中包含基于来源的修改和抄录;参考答复和正在评估的已建索赔保留在模型输入之外。

blocks.en: Following Jev’s guidance, the harness asks atomic questions, points each question to the supplied evidence and keeps counting, filtering, arithmetic and label composition in code. Jev uses its native Choice interface; the other models return candidate identifiers through a constrained JSON schema. Both questions are submitted together. This shared contract holds the evidence and downstream program fixed across models.
blocks.zh: 在Jev的引导下,绳索提出了原子问题,将每个问题指向所提供的证据,并不断在代码中计算、过滤、算术和标签组成。 Jev使用其本土选择界面;其他模型通过受限制的JSON schema返回候选标识符. 这两个问题都一并提交。 这一共享合同将证据和下游程序固定在模型之间。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Evaluation at a scientific decision point. The model selects relations from supplied evidence; shared code derives scientific outputs and composes a claim label. We score the selected relations, declared outputs and final label against separate references. The code-only branch bypasses the model.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 在科学决策点进行评价。 该模型从提供的证据中选择关系;共享代码获得科学产出并构成索赔标签。 我们根据不同的参考资料对选定的关系、申报的产出和最后标签进行评分。 只有代码分支绕过模型.

blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 三级正确性

blocks.en: These checks answer different questions. The program in Equation 1 can map distinct relations to the same quantities or final label. Conversely, it can execute a wrong relation exactly and produce a wrong scientific result. All ten model-routed reference cases have the final label inconsistent ; an always- inconsistent baseline therefore solves the label task. Semantic and joint correctness provide the substantive quality comparison.
blocks.zh: 这些检查回答了不同的问题。 方程式1中的程序可以将不同的关系映射到相同的数量或最终标签. 相反,它可以完全执行错误的关系并产生错误的科学结果。 所有10个模式路线的参考案例最终标签不一致;因此,一个总是不一致的基准解决了标签任务。 语义正确和共同正确提供了实质性的质量比较。

blocks.en: 2.3 Experimental comparison
blocks.zh: 2.3 实验比较

blocks.en: We compared twelve configurations on all ten cases, each repeated five times. Each configuration therefore had fifty planned requests and one hundred semantic answers. Configurations were evaluated in three groups, with serial requests, shuffled case order and rotating model order within each group. Repetitions measure variation on the same inputs; the scientific sample remains ten cases containing twenty Choices.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了所有10个案子的12个配置,每例重复5次。 因此,每个配置都有50项计划请求和100个语义答案。 对配置进行了三组评价,每组内有序列请求,洗牌案件顺序和旋转模型顺序. 重复测量在同一投入上的变化;科学样本仍然是10个案例,包含20种选择。

blocks.en: The primary scores use the planned denominators, with no replacement of missing responses. An absent response earns no correctness credit and is distinguished from a wrong selection. We also report correctness conditional on receiving an answer (Appendix C ). Each request was evaluated once, without retries or provider substitution. Model versions and inference settings are specified in the accompanying code and results.
blocks.zh: 初等分数使用计划分母,没有替换缺失的响应. 未作答复者没有获得正确的信用,而是与错误的选择区分开来。 我们还报告以得到答复为条件的正确性(附录C)。 每项请求都经过一次评价,没有重复或替代供应商。 模型版本和推论设置在所附的代码和结果中都有规定.

blocks.en: Latency measures elapsed client request time; we report its median and nearest-rank 95th percentile among successful responses. Cost is the known mean charge per successful response, using provider-reported charges or estimates from token usage and the applicable prices. These measurements describe the evaluated configurations under their respective service conditions.
blocks.zh: 延迟措施超过了客户要求的时间;我们报告,在成功答复中,延迟措施的中位数和最近排名为95%。 成本是已知的每个成功答复的平均收费,使用提供者报告的收费或象征性使用和适用价格的估计数。 这些衡量标准描述了各自服务条件下的评价配置。

blocks.en: Table 1: Comparison on twenty Choices in ten cases, repeated five times per configuration. Returned counts complete responses; correctness uses planned denominators and gives no credit for missing responses. Downstream and joint counts coincide in these results. Cost is the known mean successful-response cost per 1,000 requests; r r denotes reported charges and e e usage-based estimates. Preparation costs and unmeasured charges are excluded.
blocks.zh: 表1:十种选择的比较,每个配置重复五次. 返回的计数是完整的答复;正确性使用计划分母,对缺失的答复不给予任何补偿。 下游和联合计算与这些结果相吻合。 成本是已知的每1 000项请求的平均成功答复成本;r表示报告的收费和电子使用估算。 准备费用和未计量的费用不包括在内。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: 3.1 Decision quality
blocks.zh: 3.1 决定质量

blocks.en: Jev answered all one hundred planned semantic questions correctly and obtained all fifty downstream results (Table 1 ). GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026a ) , GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , Claude Sonnet 5 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) , Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) and Kimi K3 ( Moonshot AI, 2026 ) achieved the same scores. Luna made one wrong selection, Qwen Flash ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) one and Qwen Max ( Alibaba Cloud, n.d. ) five. All seven concerned the same culture-history question. Downstream and joint correctness coincided for the observed responses.
blocks.zh: Jev正确回答了所有100个计划中的语义问题,并取得了所有50个下游结果(表1)。 GPT-5.6 Sol(OpenAI,2026a),GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026b),克劳德·索内特5(Anthropic,2026b),克劳德·奥普斯5(Anthropic,2026a)和基米K3(Moonshot AI,2026)的成绩相同. 露娜做了一个错误的选择,Quen Flash (Quen Team, 2026) 1和Quen Max (Alibaba Cloud, n.d.) 5. 所有7个都涉及同一个文化-历史问题。 下游和联合正确与观测到的响应吻合。

blocks.en: Response coverage and answer quality differed for several configurations. Terra and DeepSeek configurations ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026b ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026a ) answered every received question correctly, but missing responses reduced their planned-denominator scores. Conditional scores in Appendix C distinguish these coverage differences from semantic errors.
blocks.zh: 几个组合的响应覆盖面和回答质量各不相同。 Terra和DeepSeek配置(DeepSeek-AI, 2026b;DeepSeek-AI, 2026a)对收到的每个问题都做出了正确的回答,但缺失的回复降低了其计划中的分数. 附录C中的有条件分数将这些覆盖范围差异与语义错误区分开来.

blocks.en: 3.2 Correct labels can conceal wrong quantities
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 正确的标签可以隐藏错误的数量

blocks.en: The culture-history case uses the experiments of Luria and Delbrück (1943) . Ten samples in column 11a come from one culture; ten in column 11 come from separately grown cultures. Their growth-history counts are ( 1 , 10 ) (1,10) . The question asks whether samples within each series share a culture history.
blocks.zh: 文化-历史案例使用了Luria和Delbrück(1943年)的实验. 第11a栏的10个样本来自一种文化;第11栏的10个样本来自单独生长的文化。 它们的成长历史计数为(1,10)(1,10). 问题在于每个系列中的样本是否共享文化史.

blocks.en: The seven wrong selections produced ( 10 , 1 ) (10,1) four times, ( 1 , 1 ) (1,1) twice and ( 10 , 10 ) (10,10) once. In every response, the second Choice correctly identified colonies as clonal descendants. This rejected the claim that each colony represented an independent mutation origin. The final label remained inconsistent despite the wrong growth-history counts.
blocks.zh: 制作的7个错选(10,1)(10,1)4次,(1,1)1次,(10,10)10次. 在每一个回应中,第二个选择正确地将殖民地确定为血族后裔. 这驳回了每个殖民地代表独立突变起源的说法。 最后的标签仍然不一致,尽管增长史的计算是错误的。

blocks.en: Across the 588 received results, all final labels were correct, while 581 downstream outputs were exact. This difference represents seven responses on one scientific question. It exposes a concrete failure that a label-only comparison would miss: the workflow can return the expected verdict while passing an incorrect quantity to subsequent analysis.
blocks.zh: 在588项结果中,所有最终标签都正确,而581项下游产出准确无误。 这一差异代表了对一个科学问题的七个答复。 它暴露了一个具体的失败,即只使用标签的比较会错过:工作流程可以返回预期的判断,同时将不正确的数量传递给随后的分析.

blocks.en: 3.3 Request latency and cost
blocks.zh: 3.3 请求延迟和费用

blocks.en: Jev had the lowest observed successful-request median latency, 0.335 s, with a p95 of 0.442 s. Its known mean cost was approximately $0.000060 per successful response. Among configurations with complete semantic correctness and response coverage, the next lowest median was Sol’s 1.385 s; Sol also had the next lowest cost, $0.003047 per successful response. Thus Jev combined the same observed correctness with lower request resource use in this collection.
blocks.zh: Jev的观测成功请求中位数最低,为0.335秒,p95为0.442秒。 其已知的平均费用约为每次成功答复的0.00060美元。 在完全语义正确和反应覆盖的配置中,次低中位数是Sol的1.385 s;Sol的次低成本是每成功反应0.003047美元。 因此,Jev将同样观察到的正确性与本集中请求资源使用率较低结合起来。

blocks.en: 4 Implications for Scientific Workflows
blocks.zh: 4 对科学工作流的影响

blocks.en: The comparison supports Jev as a candidate component where evidence has been prepared, candidate relations are explicit and downstream operations are specified. Its observed request economy is useful for this recurring interface between scientific text and executable rules. Preserving the semantic selections also makes it possible to inspect which relation caused a downstream discrepancy.
blocks.zh: 比较后支持Jev作为一个候选部分,其中证据已经编写,候选者关系明确,下游业务得到明确规定. 它观察到的要求节约对于科学文本与可执行规则之间的这种经常性接口是有用的. 保留语义选择还可以检查哪些关系造成下游差异。

blocks.en: The culture case extends the rationale–label distinction studied by Ho et al. (2025) to quantities that a scientific workflow could reuse. A final verdict compresses multiple clause judgments; one correctly rejected clause can conceal an error elsewhere. Evaluations of fixed-choice scientific components should therefore retain both relation-level references and the declared downstream outputs. Joint scoring checks whether the component supplies the correct relations as well as the expected result.
blocks.zh: 培养学案例将Ho等人(2025年)研究的标签区分扩大到科学工作流程可重复使用的数量。 终审判决压缩了多个条款判决;一个正确的否决条款可以掩盖其他地方的错误. 因此,对固定选择科学组成部分的评价应保留关系一级的参考和申报的下游产出。 联合检查该部分是否提供了正确的关系和预期成果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We evaluated Jev on prepared scientific decisions using shared deterministic computation and a twelve-configuration comparison. Jev combined complete observed semantic correctness with the lowest recorded successful-request median latency and known mean response cost. Separating semantic selections, downstream outputs and final labels revealed errors hidden by the final verdict, yielding a practical evaluation contract for scientific decision components.
blocks.zh: 我们利用共同的确定性计算和12个配置比较,对Jev所作的科学决定进行了评估。 Jev将观测到的完全语义正确性与记录的最低成功请求中位数和已知的平均响应成本结合起来。 分离语义选择,下游产出和最终标签揭示了最终判决所隐藏的错误,产生了科学决策成分的实用评价合同.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The comparison uses a development collection of twenty model-routed Choices in ten cases. The same curated English packets recur across repetitions, and six configurations achieve complete correctness. All observed semantic errors concern one Choice. This design characterizes the supplied decisions; evaluating transfer requires new, source-separated cases and broader relation coverage.
blocks.zh: 比较时使用了一套二十种模式化选择的十种开发集. 同样的编译的英文包在重复中反复出现,6个配置实现完全正确. 所有观察到的语义错误都涉及一个选择. 这种设计是所提供决定的特点;评价转移需要新的、与来源分开的案件和更广泛的关系范围。

blocks.en: Every model-routed reference label is inconsistent , and none of its reference Choices is not_stated , other or conflicting . The collection therefore measures relation selection and its consequences within these cases. Balanced claim decisions and uncertain-evidence cases are needed to assess label discrimination and abstention. Declared downstream outputs summarize selected scientific consequences; semantic scoring remains necessary when different relations yield identical outputs.
blocks.zh: 每个模型路由的参考标签都不一致 , 其参考选择中没有一个不为_ 描述, 其他或冲突 。 因此,该汇编将选择及其后果与这些案件有关。 需要平衡的索赔决定和不确定的证据案例来评估标签歧视和弃权。 所申报的下游产出总结了某些科学后果;当不同关系产生相同的产出时,语义评分仍然有必要。

blocks.en: Reference construction involved assisted source review and author decisions, with further source review covering fourteen of twenty model-routed Choices. Evidence preparation supplies the relevant passages and records, so the model task begins after source localization and transcription. The harness comparison uses one implemented configuration per model; its component effects would require a separate ablation study.
blocks.zh: 参考资料构建涉及协助来源审查和作者决定,进一步来源审查涉及20项模式化选择中的14项。 证据准备提供了相关的段落和记录,因此模型任务从源的定位和转录开始. 利用率比较使用每个模型一个已执行的配置;其组件效应需要单独进行消化研究。

blocks.en: Latency and cost depend on services, execution windows, reasoning settings and cache states. The resource comparison covers successful model requests. Charges for missing responses and the costs of source preparation, candidate construction, human review and local computation are unmeasured, leaving total workflow expenditure undetermined.
blocks.zh: 延迟和成本取决于服务,执行窗口,推理设置和缓存状态. 资源比较涵盖成功的模型请求。 缺失答复的收费和源头准备、候选建筑、人文审查和当地计算的费用没有计量,致使工作流程总支出无法确定。

blocks.en: Appendix A Scientific questions and case construction
blocks.zh: 科学问题和案例构建

blocks.en:
The collection contains 20 groups, 40 scientific Choices, and 25 claim outcomes.
A group shares evidence across related questions and can support more than one claim.
Ten groups, comprising 20 scientific Choices, follow deterministic rules developed on the prepared passages.
The other ten groups each contain two model-routed Choices.
Tables 2 and 3 list the complete collection and the resulting computations.
One additional candidate-omission check accompanies D01 and is excluded from scientific scores.
The 21 source records belong to 18 documented source families; related documents from the same experiment remain in one family.
blocks.zh:
该集包含20组,40个科学选择,以及25个索赔结果.
一个小组在相关问题上分享证据,可以支持不止一项索赔。
由20个科学选择组成的十组遵循在准备段落上制定的确定性规则。
其他十组各包含两个模式化的路线选择.
表2和表3列出了完整的收集以及由此产生的计算。
另有一张候选人-豁免检查随附D01,不计入科学分数.
21个来源记录属于18个有文件记载的来源家庭;同一试验的相关文件仍留在一个家庭。

blocks.en: A.1 Relations that determine scientific quantities
blocks.zh: A.1 确定科学数量的关系

blocks.en:
Several cases ask which scientific unit a recorded observation represents.
Specimens can share a build or mixing operation, scans can repeat one wear event, and minute-level measurements can share one controller allocation.
Likewise, a pooled library combines contributors, and a cosmological pair contributes one average despite requiring two simulation executions.
These distinctions determine which observations can be counted separately for the stated calculation.
blocks.zh:
有几个案例询问记录的观测所代表的科学单位。
样本可以共享一个构建或混合操作,扫描可以重复一个磨损事件,分级测量可以共享一个控制器分配.
同样,一个集合图书馆将贡献者合并在一起,一个宇宙学对像平均贡献一个,尽管需要两次模拟处决。
这些区别决定了哪些意见可以单独计算用于说明的计算.

blocks.en:
Other cases ask how a unit’s history or relationship to another unit affects interpretation.
Examples include catalyst reuse, mixed powder histories, shared culture growth, outcome-adaptive stress selection, and complementary treatment allocation.
Shared calibration uncertainty and bundled climate-model changes affect the interpretation of comparisons even when the number of reported results is unchanged.
blocks.zh:
其它情况则询问一个单位的历史或与另一个单位的关系如何影响解释。
例子包括催化剂再利用、混合粉末历史、共享培养增长、结果适应性压力选择和补充治疗分配。
共享的校准不确定性和捆绑的气候模型变化影响对比较的解释,即使所报告的结果数量不变。

blocks.en:
A further recurring question is what the evidence identifies at the selected scope.
Exposure windows distinguish administration from developmental exposure, while allele diversity in mosaic founders leaves validated germline transmission unresolved.
Incomplete provenance can establish a mixture while leaving its exact parent-lot count unknown.
Each case links a relation judgment to the quantities supported by the evidence.
blocks.zh:
另一个反复出现的问题是,证据在选定的范围内确定了什么。
接触窗口将致病性与发育性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性致病性
不完全的产地可以确定一种混合物,而其确切的母地数量却不明。
每个案件都将关系判决与证据支持的数量联系起来。

blocks.en: Table 2: Scientific relations and derived quantities for the ten groups resolved by deterministic rules developed on the prepared passages.
blocks.zh: 表2:根据所编段落制定的确定性规则,解决了这十组的科学关系和衍生数量。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ten groups in the model comparison. Each model receives both questions for a group in one request. All numeric, structural and label derivations use shared code. SMBB denotes smoothed biomass-burning forcing.
blocks.zh: 表3:模型比较中的十组. 每个模型在一次请求中都为一组人收到两个问题。 所有数字、结构和标签衍生都使用共享代码。 SMBB表示平滑的生物质燃烧强迫。

blocks.en: A.2 Evidence and reference construction
blocks.zh: A.2 证据和参考资料

blocks.en: Each input supplies a target, an explicit scope, selected evidence passages, and structured records when the calculation requires them. The passages and records were prepared from articles, supplements, scientific project documentation, a methods handbook, and an industrial case report.
blocks.zh: 每次输入都提供目标,明确范围,选定的证据通道,以及计算需要时的结构化记录. 这些段落和记录来自文章、补编、科学项目文件、方法手册和工业案例报告。

blocks.en: Reference choices, downstream outputs, and constructed claim labels are withheld from model inputs. Source explanations remain part of the evidence, including explanations that directly establish a relation. Thus, the task evaluates decisions from supplied evidence with explicit candidates.
blocks.zh: 参考选择、下游产出和已建索赔标签从模型投入中扣除。 来源解释仍然是证据的一部分,包括直接确立关系的解释。 因此,这项任务从有明确候选人提供的证据中评价各项决定。

blocks.en: References for fourteen groups received human review; the other six groups relied on assistant review. Additional source review covered 18 scientific Choices in ten groups, including 14 of the 20 model-routed Choices. The model questions outside this additional review are E004, E005 and E009. Reference construction did not include a domain-expert panel assessment or an inter-annotator agreement estimate.
blocks.zh: 14个团体的参考资料得到了人文审查;其他6个团体依靠助理审查。 补充来源审查涵盖10组中的18个科学选择,包括20个模式化选择中的14个。 本补充审查以外的模式问题为E004,E005和E009. 参考构建不包括域-专家小组评估或通知人之间的协议估计。

blocks.en: A.3 Scientific interpretation of the model-routed cases
blocks.zh: A.3 对模式程序案例的科学解释

blocks.en: The descriptions below give the two judgments, their substantive alternatives, and the reference interpretation for each model group. Questions also provide explicit missing-evidence and contradiction options, with an outside-candidate option where applicable. Missing or ambiguous evidence maps to not_stated ; unresolved incompatible evidence maps to conflicting . An established answer outside the listed alternatives maps to other . E004 additionally distinguishes partial identification from complete assignment and absent evidence. The 20 reference answers are substantive options, and every model-dependent reference outcome rejects at least one constructed claim clause.
blocks.zh: 下文的描述给出了两项判断、其实质性备选方案以及每个示范组的参考解释。 问题还提供了明确的缺失证据和矛盾选项,在适用的情况下可采用外部候选人选择。 缺少或模棱两可的证据地图不为_;未解决的不相容的证据地图相互冲突。 在列出的备选地图之外,其他地图有一个既定答案。 E004还区分了部分识别与全部任务和缺乏证据。 20个参考答案是实质性选择,每个基于模型的参考结果都拒绝至少一项推定的索赔条款。

blocks.en: The build-8-and-later top-up regime combines mixed reuse histories with partial provenance. The history alternatives distinguish a common recycling history, mixed histories, virgin replacement, and separate unmixed histories. Provenance coverage concerns each portion’s original lot, mixture fraction, and prior-build history. The reference interpretation is mixed histories with partial identification, yielding incomplete assignments and an unknown exact parent-lot count. A descriptive history label alone does not identify an original lot.
blocks.zh: 建造-8和后来的加装制度将混合再利用历史和部分来源结合起来。 历史的替代方法区分了常见的回收历史,混合历史,处女替换,以及单独的未混合历史. 证明范围涉及每个部分的原始地块、混合部分和前期建设历史。 参考解释是混杂的历史,有部分识别,产生不完整的任务和未知的准确的父地数量。 仅一个描述历史的标签并不能识别原始的批量.

blocks.en: Stress selection depends on the preceding outcome, and the next test uses a new specimen. The alternatives separate this adaptive rule from independent randomization, fixed stress, or a predetermined schedule. They also distinguish specimen replacement from further loading of the same specimen or testing a whole foil. The documented starting stress of 325 MPa and step of 30 MPa yield 295 MPa after failure and 355 MPa after runout. These values instantiate the regular-staircase rule; the observed fixed-stress replicate count remains unknown.
blocks.zh: 压力选择取决于之前的结果,下一次测试使用一个新的标本. 替代品将这一适应规则与独立的随机化,固定应力,或预先设定的时间表区分开来. 它们还区分了更换标本与进一步装载同一标本或测试整个软体。 记录的325 MPa的起始应力和30 MPa的步数在失败后产生295 MPa,排出后产生355 MPa. 这些值即时化成正轨规则;观测到的固定压力复制计数仍然未知.

blocks.en: Phase reversal couples the initial fields, and the pair average is the statistic entering the ensemble. The candidate relations include independent initial draws, identical fields, and output resampling. Alternative aggregation units are individual executions, pair differences, and one average over all runs. For the N1000 subset, the reference gives 100 paired realizations, 200 executions, and 100 ensemble values. These counts describe initial-field coupling and the source-defined aggregation unit; they do not specify an effective sample size for every evolved observable.
blocks.zh: 相向倒置对夫妇 初始字段,对偶平均值 是统计进入综艺。 候选关系包括独立的初始图纸,相同的字段,以及输出重印. 其他的汇总单位是个别处决、对数差异和所有处决的平均数。 对于N1000子集,参考给出了100对实现,200处处决,以及100个综艺值. 这些计数描述了初始域耦合和源定义的聚合单位;它们没有为每一个演化的可观测对象指定有效的样本大小.

blocks.en: The ensemble contains two protocol groups, with 50 members using the original forcing and 50 using SMBB. The candidates contrast this division with a uniform original or SMBB protocol, and distinguish smoothing alone, bundled changes, and initialization alone. The reference identifies bundled changes, including documented emission and carbon-flux code corrections, so the comparison cannot isolate smoothing alone.
blocks.zh: 综艺节目包含两个协议组,有50名成员使用原强制,50名成员使用SMBB. 考生将这种划分与统一的原创或SMBB协议作对比,单独区分平滑,捆绑变化,单独初始化. 该参考物识别了捆绑的变化,包括有文件记载的排放和碳通量代码校正,因此比较不能单独孤立平滑.

blocks.en:
The compared results share reference-calibration uncertainty, and two secondary-laboratory visits form a bracketing average.
The alternatives distinguish the shared contribution from independent references or identical measurements, and the average from two laboratories or an adjustment contrast. The reference therefore gives two compared laboratory results from three visits, with 2 ​ u B ​ ( std DCV ) 2 2u_{B}(\mathrm{std}_{\mathrm{DCV}})^{2} subtracted in the uncertainty expression. The exact effective replication count remains unknown.
blocks.zh:
比较结果与参考校准不确定性相同,两次二级实验室访问构成一个括号中的平均值。
替代品区分了共享贡献与独立参考或相同计量,以及两个实验室的平均值或调整对比。 因此,参考文献给出了三次访问得出的两个比较实验室结果,其中2 u B (std DCV ) 2u_{B}(\mathrm{std}_{\mathrm{DCV}} }}) 在不确定性表达式中减去。 准确有效的复制数量仍然不明。

blocks.en: Complementary allocation makes each treatment decision joint across the two ranges. The alternatives include independent assignments, seeding both ranges, and permanent range assignment. An assignment label identifies treatment allocation; it establishes neither zero exposure nor confirmed exposure everywhere. Using the authors’ reported totals, 154 − 27 − 9 = 118 154-27-9=118 , the reference gives 118 joint assignments and 236 range-level records. The published monthly generator-exclusion cells sum to eight, whereas the margins and prose report nine; the missing event is unresolved.
blocks.zh: 补充拨款使每个治疗决定在两个范围共同作出。 替代办法包括独立派任、播种和永久派任。 任务标签确定治疗分配;它既不确定零接触,也不确定任何地方确认的接触。 根据提交人报告的总数154 - 27 - 9 = 118 154 - 27 - 9=118, 参考文献提供了118项联合任务和236项射程级记录。 公布的每月生成-排除细胞共8个,而边距和传言报告为9个;缺失事件尚未解决.

blocks.en:
Injection of pregnant F0 dams exposes the mother, embryo, and fetal germline within the source’s defined window.
The administration alternatives include separate treatment of every generation, F3 animals alone, and isolated germ cells.
The exposure alternatives distinguish the full window from maternal-only exposure, mother plus embryo, or exposure of every later descendant generation. The selected dioxin rows contain 162 F3 pups in 14 weaned litters, with zero newly injected F3 animals. Under the source’s exposure-window definition, F3 is the first generation beyond that window. The number of distinct F0 ancestors remains unknown.
blocks.zh:
对怀孕的F0大坝的注射暴露了源定窗口内的母亲、胚胎和胎儿的亲缘关系。
施药的替代品包括对每代动物、单F3动物和孤立的细菌进行单独治疗。
接触的替代品将全窗与只接触产妇、母亲和胚胎或后世每一代人的接触区分开来。 选定的二恶英排在14个断奶的垃圾中含有162只F3幼崽,新注入的F3动物为零. 根据来源的曝光窗定义,F3是该窗口以外的第一代. 不同的F0祖先的数量仍然未知.

blocks.en: Experiments 11a and 11 contrast shared and separate culture growth histories, respectively. The ten plating records in each series therefore correspond to one and ten growth histories. The candidate history patterns also include the reverse assignment, separate histories in both experiments, and shared histories in both. The selected columns contain 514 and 624 colonies, but clonal descendants leave the number of mutation origins unknown. The origin alternatives are one origin per cell, new origins created only at selection, and repeated images of one colony. The records are the complete selected columns of Tables 1 and 2.
blocks.zh: 实验11a和11分别分享和分别介绍了文化成长史。 因此,每个系列的10个电镀记录与1个和10个增长历史相对应。 候选历史模式还包括反派任务、两个实验中分别的历史以及两个实验中共享的历史。 所选的栏目包含514个和624个殖民地,但杂交后代留下的突变起源数量不详. 原产地替代物是每个细胞一个原产地,只有在选择时才会产生新的原产地,以及一个聚居地的重复图像. 记录是表1和表2的完整选定栏目。

blocks.en:
Physical RNA pooling before library preparation produces aggregate expression profiles. The candidates distinguish this operation from indexed-library pooling, numerical averaging, and tissue pooling before extraction. The attribution alternatives include complete or partial individual profiles and a newly sampled animal. The four selected eight-animal libraries contain 16 distinct contributors and 32 contributor appearances, with zero separately observed contributor profiles.
The source’s separate individual-library arm remains in the evidence but lies outside the selected pooled-arm claim.
blocks.zh:
物理 RNA 集合在库编写前生成集合表达式配置. 考生将这一操作与索引图书馆集合、数值平均和提取前的组织集合区分开来。 归属替代方法包括完整或部分的个人特征和新取样的动物。 四个选定的八动物图书馆包含16个不同的贡献者和32个贡献者外表,没有单独观察到的贡献者简介。
来文方单独的个人图书馆臂留在证据中,但不属于选定的集合图书馆臂主张的范围。

blocks.en: Within-founder mosaicism and an inherited albino allele limit the attribution of alleles and transmission from founder counts and phenotype. The mosaicism alternatives are one uniform allele pair, one founder per allele, and no detected edit. The marker alternatives contrast the pre-existing allele with a unique new-allele marker, absent germ cells, and complete allele-specific transmission verification. The reported aggregate is 23 sequenced hybrid founders and 57 mutant alleles; the number of validated new germline lines remains unknown. For founder 30, manuscript prose reports five alleles whereas publisher Figure 3C lists six entries. Both establish allele diversity, so the reference uses mosaicism without assigning an exact founder-30 allele total.
blocks.zh: 创始人马赛克主义和继承的白化亚麻(albino alea)限制了亚麻的归属和从创始人计数和苯基的传播. 镶嵌主义的替代品是一对统一的阿莱莱,每个阿莱莱有一个创建者,没有检测到编辑. 标记替代品将原有的亚麻黄素与独特的新亚麻黄素标记作对比,缺失细菌细胞,完成亚麻黄素特异性传输验证. 报告的总数是23个序列杂交创始人和57个变种亚麻;经过验证的新细菌线的数目仍然不明。 对于创始人30,手稿传言报告5个全集,而出版商图3C则列出6个条目. 两者都建立了allele多样性,因此参考使用mosaicism,而没有分配精确的创始人-30 allele总计.

blocks.en: A.4 Deterministic derivation and claim composition
blocks.zh: A.4 决定因素和索赔组成

blocks.en:
Deterministic rules match complete prepared evidence passages and resolve the ten groups in Table 2 within their stated scope. The model route supplies the remaining semantic selections.
All selections feed the same operations for arithmetic, filtering, deduplication, covariance substitution, and claim composition. Missing answers and invalid options remain response failures. Unknown scientific quantities remain explicitly unknown rather than becoming zero.
blocks.zh:
确定性规则与已准备好的完整证据段落相符,并在其规定的范围内解决表2中的十类问题。 模型路线提供剩余的语义选择.
所有选择都为计算、过滤、调试、共变替代和索赔构成提供相同的操作。 缺少答案和无效选项仍然是响应失败. 未知的科学数量仍然明确不明,而不是变为零。

blocks.en: For E001–E010 and B001–B004, an unresolved contradiction takes precedence over an outside-candidate answer, which takes precedence over missing evidence. These alternatives remain distinct and stop label composition. A substantive partial-identification answer, as in E004, can still produce an output with unknown fields. For biological compound claims, an inconsistent clause determines the final inconsistent label even when another clause lacks sufficient evidence. This composition rule can preserve the final label after an intermediate semantic error.
blocks.zh: 就E001-E010和B001-B004而言,一个尚未解决的矛盾优先于外部候选人的答复,后者优先于缺失的证据。 这些替代品仍然各异,并停止标签构成。 如E004中那样,实质性的局部识别答案仍然可以产生未知字段的输出. 对于生物复合物索赔,即使另一条款缺乏充分证据,一个不一致的条款也确定了最终不一致的标签。 这个组成规则可以在中间语义错误后保留最终标签.

blocks.en: The code-only condition uses the same rules and leaves the residual questions unresolved. The reference-oracle condition supplies the reference Choices to the shared derivations for all 20 groups, checking implementation conditional on those references. E008 compares complete coded settings: its source’s differing physical-temperature descriptions do not alter the specified equality calculation.
blocks.zh: 只代码条件使用相同的规则,留下剩余问题未解决. 参考-甲骨文条件为所有20个群体提供了共同衍生物的参考选择,以这些参考物为条件检查执行情况。 E008比较完整的编码设置:其来源不同的物理温度描述并不改变指定的等值计算.

blocks.en: Appendix B Metric Definitions and Output Coverage
blocks.zh: 附录B 计量定义和产出覆盖范围

blocks.en: Let i ∈ { 1 , … , 10 } i\in\{1,\ldots,10\} index cases, t ∈ { 1 , … , 5 } t\in\{1,\ldots,5\} repetitions and k ∈ { 1 , 2 } k\in\{1,2\} Choices. Write s i ​ t ​ k = 1 s_{itk}=1 when the received option exactly matches its reference, and zero otherwise. Let d i ​ t d_{it} indicate exact agreement on the case’s declared downstream fields, and ℓ i ​ t \ell_{it} exact agreement on its canonical final label. Missing responses set each indicator to zero. blocks.en: Table 4 specifies the scientific quantities and properties assessed by downstream exactness. These include counts, counts by group, Boolean properties, symbolic covariance terms and unknown values. Selected options and final labels are scored separately; intermediate claim judgments are excluded from downstream exactness. Exactness requires agreement in both value and type for every declared field: an omitted value differs from an explicitly unknown quantity, and a Boolean differs from a number. Reference quantities that are unknown must also remain unknown in the prediction.
blocks.zh: 表4按下游精确度列出了评估的科学数量和性质。 这些包括计数,按组计数,布尔属性,符号共性术语和未知值. 选定的选择和最终标签分别打分;中间索赔判决从下游准确性中排除。 准确性要求每个已声明字段的值和类型都一致:省略的值与明确未知的数量不同,布尔值与数字不同. 在预测中,未知的参考数量也必须是未知的。

blocks.en: The final label combines the judgments of the individual claim clauses. A rejected clause makes the overall claim inconsistent; otherwise an unresolved clause yields insufficient evidence, and a claim with all clauses supported is consistent. The reference labels in this comparison are all inconsistent.
blocks.zh: 最后的标签结合了个人索赔条款的判决。 一项被驳回的条款使整个索赔要求不一致;否则一项未解决的条款产生不充分的证据,一项附有所有支持条款的索赔要求是前后一致的。 此比较中的参考标签都不一致.

blocks.en: Downstream and joint scores coincide empirically because each observed semantic error changes a growth-history count.
blocks.zh: 下游和联合得分在经验上吻合,因为每个观察到的语义错误都会改变生长-历史计数.

blocks.en: Table 4: Declared scientific outputs used for downstream exactness. These fields capture selected consequences of a Choice; semantic scoring covers distinctions that do not change the recorded outputs. Null entries include quantities not established by the supplied evidence.
blocks.zh: 表4:用于下游精确度的申报科学产出。 这些字段捕捉选择的选定后果;语义评分涵盖不改变记录产出的区分。 编号包括提供的证据未确定的数量。

blocks.en: Different semantic selections can produce the same declared output. For example, E005-Q02 asks whether a new specimen receives the next stress setting; this answer does not enter the recorded stress calculation. Semantic and joint correctness still require the reference selection. Downstream exactness therefore applies to the declared fields rather than every possible consequence of a relation.
blocks.zh: 不同的语义选择可以产生相同的宣布输出. 例如,E005-Q02询问一个新的标本是否收到下一个应力设置;这个答案没有输入记录的应力计算. 语义和联合正确性仍然需要参考选择. 因此,下游准确性适用于申报的字段,而不是关系的所有可能后果。

blocks.en: Appendix C Correctness Conditional on a Received Response
blocks.zh: 附录C 正确性 收到答复的条件

blocks.en: Table 5 uses only received, complete responses. It complements the planned-denominator results: a route with low availability may return correct answers for a selective subset of cases. Each received response supplies two semantic answers and one group output. No absent answer is treated as a semantic mistake or as an insufficient-evidence selection.
blocks.zh: 表5仅使用了收到的完整答复。 它补充了计划中的分解结果:一个可用性低的路径可能会对选定的子集案例返回正确的答案. 每个答复都提供了两个语义答案和一个组输出。 没有缺漏的答案被视为语义错误或证据不足选择。

blocks.en: Table 5: Correct outputs among received responses. Availability is reported separately in Table 1 . Versions are those listed in the main table.
blocks.zh: 表5:收到答复中正确的产出。 可用性在表1中另行报告。 版本是主表中列出的版本.

blocks.en: All 588 received labels match their references, compared with 581 exact downstream results and 1,169 correct Choices out of 1,176. The seven semantic errors each alter a growth-history count while preserving the final label, illustrating the distinction between the three evaluation levels.
blocks.zh: 所有588个获得的标签都符合其参考文献,而下游的准确结果为581个,1 176个中有1 169个正确选择。 七个语义错误在保留最终标签的同时,每个都改变生长史计数,说明三个评价级别之间的区别.
